name: Cluster Culling (Nanite-style)
definition: A hierarchical clustering and culling system for Gaussian splats, implementing Nanite-style spatial clustering for efficient LOD and frustum culling.
summary: Cluster Culling (Nanite-style) is a hierarchical culling and LOD selection mechanism for 3D Gaussian Splatting that reduces rendering overhead by testing cluster bounding spheres against the view frustum and calculating screen-space error.
